📦 **meadow-citylogos `ab8995a`** — feat: scale world-map town logos by live population and enlarge markers

Six individually generated 128px transparent pixel towns replace circular house badges. Use inclusive population ceilings 500/1000/2000/5000/10000, live population first including zero, startup population only before ledger creation. Redraw on ledger day advancement and image load, with a circle-free house fallback.

48px image slots yield about39px building silhouettes. Update square hit areas, collision spacing, labels and port stems together. Preserve faction port dots and docking/navigation cues without a badge circle. world/ assets follow existing packaging automatically; no battle rebuild.

Validation: 20 boundary/invalid cases, real population500->501->0, all6 production renderer image selections,6 PNG dimensions and SHA matches, load/error invalidation, missing-image fallback,3 hit checks,12 coincident port markers, inline JS parse. Actual IAB globe screenshot and click-to-sail arrival at Santiago (1800 people, tier3), console errors empty. Gallery0022e48,1116 exhibits. Evidence and reproducible checks included.

Refs TASK-1076

👥 參與者：@meadow
